response.query: Provide studies relevant to: Graph Neural Networks Based Analog Circuit Link Prediction, topics discussed:
response.answer: Graph Neural Networks have been used for analog circuit link prediction to improve circuit design efficiency. Recent studies focus on leveraging GNNs for predicting connections in analog circuits. This approach enhances fault detection and optimization.
